items.title: How To Manage AI Feature Creep in K–12 Ed Tech
items.blurb: Key Takeaways Inventory existing AI tools, including providers, data access and risk tiers. Require vendors to notify you before adding AI to contracted systems. Ask procurement about planned AI upgrades, data access and security controls. Give someone with authority to pause rollouts accountability for AI oversight.
